title: AI-RiddleQuest
tagline: AI-RIDDLE-QUEST: A decentralized riddle competition on Arbitrum Sepolia powered by OnChain AI (Llama3 8B). Solve AI-generated riddles, get scored on-chain, and win prizes! Fair, transparent, and trustless. 🧠✨ #AI #Web3 #Riddles
description:
AI-Riddle-Quest combines artificial intelligence, blockchain, and game theory to create a fair and transparent competition where users solve AI-generated riddles to win rewards. Unlike traditional games, the riddle generation, answer evaluation, and scoring happen on-chain via an AI oracle (Ora-AI), making the system trustless and verifiable.

 #Oracle-Integrated AI (Ora-AI)
Generates riddles dynamically based on chosen themes.
Evaluates answers using AI-powered scoring to ensure fairness.
🔗 On-Chain Decentralized Scoring
AI calculates scores on-chain, ensuring tamper-proof and transparent results.
Eliminates human bias or manipulation.
🏆 Prize Distribution via Smart Contracts
Winners can claim rewards automatically if they meet the required score.
No central authority—fully trustless system.
🛡️ Secure and Fair Gameplay
Riddle generation and evaluation are handled by Llama3 8B AI, ensuring no one can manipulate results.
Uses Arbitrum Sepolia’s blockchain for fast, low-cost transactions.
how_its_made:
AI-Riddle-Quest is a fully decentralized application that merges on-chain AI, smart contracts, and oracles to create and score logic-based riddles on the Arbitrum Sepolia testnet.
This project made using Ora-Onchain AI oracle using proxy address on arbitrumSepolia, nextjs, smartcontract, database.
